label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
name: Terraform validate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

# This workflow does not run terraform plan or apply.
# Plan/apply need an Azure subscription and credentials. This portfolio
# repository is a lab; CI only proves the configuration is syntactically
# valid and internally consistent.
jobs:
  validate:
    name: terraform validate (${{ matrix.environment }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        environment: [dev, prod]
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.9.8
          terraform_wrapper: false

      - name: Initialize providers (no backend)
        working-directory: terraform/environments/${{ matrix.environment }}
        run: terraform init -backend=false -input=false -no-color

      - name: Validate configuration
        working-directory: terraform/environments/${{ matrix.environment }}
        run: terraform validate -no-color
